summary: Santa Cruz/Graciosa Bay/Luova Airport (SCZ/AGGL) is a small domestic airstrip serving the easternmost islands of the Solomon Islands, located on Santa Cruz Island (Nendo) in the remote Temotu Province. The airport provides a vital air link between this isolated island group and the rest of the country, as sea travel is slow and weather-dependent. It primarily handles short-haul flights operated by Solomon Airlines using small turboprop aircraft.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines fly to Santa Cruz/Graciosa Bay/Luova Airport?
A: Solomon Airlines is the main carrier operating regular domestic flights to this airport, typically using small turboprop aircraft suitable for short runways.

Q: Are there international flights at SCZ?
A: No, Santa Cruz/Graciosa Bay/Luova Airport only handles domestic flights within the Solomon Islands. International travelers typically connect through Honiara.

Q: How long is the flight from Honiara to SCZ?
A: The flight from Honiara International Airport to Santa Cruz typically takes around 2 hours, depending on aircraft type and weather conditions.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small regional airport, facilities are basic, typically including a small terminal building. Travelers should expect limited amenities and bring their own supplies.
transport_tips: Getting to and from the airport usually requires arranging local transport in advance, as taxi services are informal and limited on Santa Cruz Island. The airport is located near the town of Luova, and most accommodations can arrange pickups with advance notice. Rental vehicles are generally not available, so hiring a local vehicle with driver is the most common option for traveling around the island.
local_tip: Bring sufficient cash in Solomon Islands dollars, as ATM access and card payment facilities are extremely limited on Santa Cruz Island, and the airport area has no banking services.
